_about: Component spec for pos-switch-card (docs/inspect refactor, component migration batch, 2026-08-26). Single source of truth for the Variants/Usage/Tokens tabs on /style-guide "Switch button" section. Reuses the already-curated usage prose from COMP_CONFIGS['switch-card'].usage and token data from the existing inspect-switch-card.liquid (verified-accurate, currently-live data) restructured into the new schema. Single representative variant — this component's preview shows one instance (no Variant/Base toggle needed per the 2026-08-25/26 "multiple sub-variants side by side" rule). Regenerate the spec partial with the script in RULES.md 6.4 if the source data changes; do not hand-edit token values here. Rebuilt 2026-08-26 after finding the migration only carried the 'switch-default' (off) variant's normal+focus states, silently dropping Disabled/Selected/Selected-disabled — now includes all 6 states the component's real State control offers, mapped from switch-card's 4 named variants (default/checked/disabled/selected-disabled) in inspect-switch-card.liquid, which was itself fixed at the same time (focus states were missing Color/Typography, hover state did not exist at all). Confirmed via pos-switch-card.css: Disabled and Selected-disabled use real dedicated color tokens, never CSS opacity. Updated 2026-08-27: added usageExample/props/composedOf (Target architecture point 1 fields that were left empty when this spec was first generated). Renamed to "Switch button" and rebuilt 2026-09-16: the card's background/border (and label/icon) must never change in any state — only .pos-switch-card-toggle reacts, now reusing the exact same on/off/disabled token scheme as the standalone Toggle button (pos-toggle-btn.css) instead of switch-card's old color-mix-based primary color scheme. Hover no longer has any distinct CSS, so its token table is now identical to normal's — documented as such, not invented. 2026-09-16: hover regained one distinct effect — a 2px interactive-color inset stroke on the card via the pos-anim-stroke behavior pattern (pos-behaviors.css), matching Choice button (.pos-tile-btn). Background/border/label/icon still never change; only the toggle track/thumb and now this stroke react to state. 2026-10-02: the toggle inside the card gets the Toggle button's hover (off -> prominent text color, on -> interactive hover, HC frame); disabled cards none. Disabled checked fill/frame borrows the primary button disabled tokens (--pos-color-button-primary-disabled-background / -frame) — documented exception to RULES.md 2.2, see COMPONENT-RULES.md.
name: Switch button
description: Letting users toggle a feature or setting on or off — especially when the option has a name and an icon that benefits from a larger, more prominent touch target.
whenToUse: Letting users toggle a feature or setting on or off — especially when the option has a name and an icon that benefits from a larger, more prominent touch target.
Presenting a small set of independent boolean options that each deserve visual weight (e.g. accessibility preferences, feature flags).
whenNotToUse: The toggle is a simple inline switch with no icon or label prominence — use a standard form checkbox or toggle switch instead.
Multiple tightly-grouped options — switch buttons take up significant vertical space.
do: Always use <label> as the root element wrapping <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> — this gives the entire row a correct accessible click target.
Use a meaningful aria-label or visible label text that describes exactly what the switch controls.
Use an icon that visually represents the feature being toggled.
dont: Use the switch button as a navigation element — it is a toggle, not a link.
Omit the role="switch" attribute — without it, screen readers announce it as a checkbox, not a toggle switch.
accessibility: The hidden <input type="checkbox" role="switch"> carries all semantics. Screen readers announce the label and checked state automatically.
The card receives focus (not the hidden input) — the :focus-visible ring appears on the <label> via the :has(:focus-visible) selector.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled attribute on .pos-switch-card-input — the whole row shows cursor: not-allowed (pointer events stay on, the disabled input ignores the click, no hover; RULES.md 4.12); only the toggle track/thumb dim, the row itself keeps its normal appearance.

props.name: checked
props.description: On/off state — switches only .pos-switch-card-toggle to the Toggle button's "on" color; the row's background, border, label, and icon never change.

constants.role: Card background — constant across all states
Icon circle background — constant across all states
Icon color — constant across all states
Toggle thumb — constant across all states, same pattern as the Toggle button's own thumb

tokens.role: Card hover stroke (2px inset outline, pos-anim-stroke behavior — matches Choice button)
Toggle track on hover (off) — one step stronger than the resting track
Toggle track on hover (on) — the interactive hover step
Toggle hover frame, 2px off the track — only visible in high contrast
